title.narrative: Building Better Cities Through Better Urban Managers

description.narrative: "The program built on the success of the pilot Mayors Executive Education Program, jointly organized by the Academy of Managers for Construction and Cities (AMC) and WBI, on December 14 to 18, 2009 in Hanoi. This course covered 35 class 1, 2 and 3 cities. In response to the request from the Government of Vietnam (Ministry of Construction), the program assisted the AMC to strengthen its role as the lead institution and coordinator of capacity building programs for city leaders (in partnership with ACVN, VIAP and other key agencies in urban development) by scaling up this Executive Program to cover a broader set of topics on urban planning and city management. Towards this end, the program had the following components: a) Development of Modules on Urban Planning and City Management ($70K). AMC has limited experience in offering broader urban planning and management courses to city leaders and technical staff. To date, it has employed traditional methods of capacity building (e.g. ""mass training"") focused primarily on the construction sector. With support from international and local experts, the AMC further developed the mayors executive education course with additional topics. b) Training of Trainers (TOT) Program ($30K): The ToT workshops targeted AMC faculty and staff and trainers from other universities and departments. c) Pilot delivery of the course(s) ($20K). The grant supported the pilot delivery of the course with a focus on secondary cities not covered in the December 2009 Executive course delivery. These activities were completed as of June 2013. The objective of this work is to develop the capacity of the Academy for Managers of Construction and Cities to develop and deliver high quality executive training for Mayors and Vice Mayors of Vietnamese (medium sized) cities."
